Elena (PM): Proposal: ship a conservative Optimize Toolkit pilot. Scope: 1) read-only recommendation API for batching/caching/quant suggestions; 2) daily eval-triggered alerts with tenant-configurable thresholds; 3) small admin surface (mute, preview, revert). Target two pilots in ~7 weeks.

Marcus (Eng): Agree on read-only first. Rollout: tenant flag -> 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with latency and error gates. Need perf harness matching Notesly traffic.

Rina (Data): Suggested eval metrics: top-1/top-3 concordance, perplexity delta, token-savings estimate. Defaults + tenant override. Example rule: concordance < 0.9 over 72h => warning.

Omar (Runtime): Runtime constraints: quant availability varies by model. Add `quality_tier` param (high|medium|low) and `safe_mode` opt-in. Telemetry tags required: rec_source, suggested_quant, cache_hit, est_tokens_saved.

Leah (Design): Admin UX: compact widget on route page showing estimated savings, recent alerts, preview diff, and quick mute/revert buttons. I can mock a 1-panel design.

bot-deploy: Staging deploy queued at 1752115000 :rocket:

Elena (PM): Launch criteria: two pilots onboarded, telemetry emitted, p95 <= 1.2x baseline for common routes, docs + runbook ready. Owners: Marcus -> perf plan & harness (Thu). Omar -> telemetry contract + fallback chain (Mon). Rina -> threshold presets & pilot datasets (Fri). Leah -> admin mock (Wed). I'll handle pilot invites and legal.
